Header status is still a mono middot string that repeats the proof line, and ~100px of empty paper sits under the filmstrip.

distinctiveness.notes: 390-full.jpg mid-page: the header clock advances with scroll (09:15 plus progress hairline). 1440-full.jpg: Time Card Punch runs through hero card, filmstrip, how rail, 10:30 break, 11:40 reviews, 12:00 stamp and punched Hours card. Unlike siblings B and C.

type.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the red mono 01-09 row numbers in services are decorative numbering (RUBRIC §5). Mono is still used in chips, table heads and header status (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Orphans fixed; display set well (1440-first.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: round-3 dead zones (hero right, footer right, white #how) are filled and the tone rhythm is clean. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: ~450px dark void under the visit-card intro column; the booking section repeats the short-left/tall-right pattern.

photo.notes: 390-full.jpg: break fixed, with gun, bead and tub in frame. 1440-rm-full.jpg: plates are a consistent drawn set. 1440-full.jpg break band: the tub interior is now a flat pure-white slab, the caption overlaps the tub curve and the bead is short.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: plain on-thesis lines, one primary action, Sample labels on rating/prices/reviews/licence (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). 1440-scroll-25.jpg: 'Half-day visits' and 'Full-day visits' are listed as jobs to tick, minor.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: break and clock overhang fixed; sticky bar, stacked pricing and checklists work (390-first.jpg). The 07:50 card still stacks tall with mostly empty paper (390-full.jpg).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show all content with reduced motion; static.json and render.json are clean with no overflow. The grey body text in #how on warm paper is light but legible (1440-full.jpg).

motion.notes: 390-full.jpg: the scroll-linked header clock gives one continuous idea; 1440-scroll-75.jpg: reveals no longer blank. The rail pills don't ink as the clock passes them (1440-scroll-50.jpg), so the rail and the clock are two separate systems.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the visit card is a designed artifact (punch holes, 08:00-12:00 stamp, Book/Print); 1440-full.jpg: punched Hours card plus 12:00 stamp land the page. Only the empty state is ever shown.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: consistent stamps and radius, and the footer is composed. The amber second accent makes the footer Call button the only non-red primary (1440-full.jpg bottom).
